items.title: Ben Kelly Interview, 1960-08-11
items.q: Hardly anybody ever saved a picture of Buddy Petit.

ctx.x: No, I had one of these photographs, and that photograph just got this missing from you. And I inquired, and I wiped, but I could not find that picture.
It was too bad. I'd like to see a picture of him. Same way with Buddy Petit. Hardly anybody ever saved a picture of Buddy Petit.

I had one in that picture of somebody. Clipped that picture, I don't know. His wife over took it to work and moved and tell me about it. And I had been to her home, and I didn't wipe and watch on the fly. But I never did see. I never could find that picture.
